title.zh: 复盘：缩小篇幅后，哪一点仍能被认出
title.en: Review what remains recognisable when the pages shrink

paragraphs.zh: 回到小刊的例子，先用一句话说核心想法，再画一个少页数版本。比较两版时，分别看哪些只是形式、哪些确实让意思消失。可以只草拟，不必找伙伴验证。复盘关注想法是否讲得清、别人是否还有创作空间；保留一处重点不需要保留所有安排，采用共同修改也不等于失去自己的声音。
paragraphs.en: For the zine, state its central idea in a sentence and sketch a version with fewer pages. Distinguish changed form from a lost meaning. Draft without recruiting a collaborator. Review a clear idea and room for others’ contributions. Keeping a central detail need not preserve every arrangement, and accepting a shared revision need not erase your voice.

title.zh: 借一个创作场景交换想法
title.en: Exchange ideas through a creative scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一本共同小刊要减掉一半页数，你最想留下哪个想法，又愿意让哪些形式一起重做？”各提一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不要求合作、发消息或证明像哪个人物。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a shared zine lost half its pages, which idea would you retain and which parts of its form would you redesign together?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without collaborating, sending a message or proving resemblance.

title.zh: 复盘：共同时间里，也留个人的选择
title.en: Review individual choice within shared time

paragraphs.zh: 沿用短暂喝饮品的邀请，设想三种回答：一起休息、换一种方式、这次各做各的。给每种都留一个自然结尾，也想想自己今天想怎样度过。可以只构思一句邀请。复盘关注小心意是否贴合双方，而非是否换来亲近；一个普通晚上可以有联结，也可以平静地各自做事，不由拒绝一次推断关系远近。
paragraphs.en: For the short drink break, imagine joining, changing the format or doing separate things. Give each an easy ending and consider your own preference today. Draft an invitation without sending it. Review a gesture’s fit for both people rather than the closeness it produces. An ordinary evening can include connection or separate activities without a single refusal determining the relationship.

title.zh: 借一个创作场景交换想法
title.en: Exchange ideas through a creative scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果共享兴趣空间的一晚没有特别安排，你会怎样邀请一小段共同休息，同时让各自做事也自在？”各提一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不要求合作、发消息或证明像哪个人物。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “On an ordinary evening in a shared hobby space, how would you offer a short break together while making separate activities comfortable too?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without collaborating, sending a message or proving resemblance.

title.zh: 复盘：喜欢的细节与可交接的版本分开
title.en: Review the detail beside a usable handover

paragraphs.zh: 回到一处过渡或页面细节，分别记想探索什么、当前版本能做什么，以及什么时候先交接。可以只比较两个草稿，不必继续打磨。复盘看变化是否符合这次目的、过程是否仍有趣；别人需要往下做时，说清版本比无止境完善更有用。暂停、保留粗糙感或转向另一处，都不由角色结果评为不够投入。
paragraphs.en: For a transition or page detail, distinguish what you want to explore, what the current version can do and a handover time. Compare drafts without further polishing. Review the purpose and enjoyment of this attempt. A clear version can serve collaborators better than indefinite refinement. Pausing, keeping a rough edge or changing focus is no lack of commitment certified by a character result.

title.zh: 借一个创作场景交换想法
title.en: Exchange ideas through a creative scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只有半小时打磨一页作品，你最想试哪个细节，又怎样说明哪一版已经可以先交给伙伴？”各提一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不要求合作、发消息或证明像哪个人物。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “With half an hour for one page, which detail would you explore and how would you identify a version ready for a collaborator?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without collaborating, sending a message or proving resemblance.

title.zh: 复盘：资源够用，也要重新问意愿

paragraphs.zh: 沿用一间房、一个短晚上的活动，先区分现有资源、还没确认的贡献和大家仍想实现的目的。若有人少了时间，比较缩小、延后或换形式，不把空缺默认交给某个人。可以只改纸上方案。复盘看计划是否仍由参与者共同选择，而非只看活动是否办成；资源安排不产生支配别人时间的权利。
paragraphs.en: For an event with one room and a short evening, separate available resources, unconfirmed contributions and a purpose people still want. If someone has less time, compare shrinking, delaying or changing the format without assigning the gap by default. Revise on paper. Review a plan people still choose together rather than mere completion; resource planning grants no control over someone else’s time.

title.zh: 借一个创作场景交换想法
title.en: Exchange ideas through a creative scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一次小展示只有一间房和一个晚上，你会怎样商量可做的规模，以及有人临时少了时间时怎么改？”各提一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不要求合作、发消息或证明像哪个人物。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “With one room and one evening for a small showcase, how would you agree its scale and revise it if someone’s time decreased?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without collaborating, sending a message or proving resemblance.

title.zh: 复盘：欣赏、理解与建议分别说
title.en: Review appreciation, interpretation and advice separately

paragraphs.zh: 回到未完成草图，分别写一处具体喜欢的细节、自己读到的意思，以及尚不确定的地方。建议可以另问是否需要，不必和欣赏绑在一起。只用虚构作品也可以。复盘关注回应有没有贴近对方分享的目的；理解不同可以说清，欣赏也不自动构成持续帮忙的承诺，更不用对方赞同来证明自己真诚。
paragraphs.en: For the unfinished sketch, name an enjoyable detail, your interpretation and an uncertainty. Ask separately whether advice is wanted rather than bundling it with appreciation. A fictional piece is enough. Review the purpose of the exchange. Different interpretations can be clarified; appreciation promises no continuing help and needs no agreement to certify sincerity.

title.zh: 借一个创作场景交换想法
title.en: Exchange ideas through a creative scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友只想给你看一张草图，你会怎样说出具体欣赏，再问这次想听感受、建议还是只展示？”各提一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不要求合作、发消息或证明像哪个人物。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend shared a sketch, how would you express specific appreciation and ask whether they wanted a reaction, advice or simply to show it?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without collaborating, sending a message or proving resemblance.

title.zh: 复盘：试过以后，角色还可以调整
title.en: Review room to revise the role after trying it

paragraphs.zh: 回到陌生任务的小版本，分别想起步前需要什么支持、试到哪一步再决定，以及什么变化要告诉伙伴。可以只设想分工，不必接受真实任务。复盘只记录这次更了解了什么，保留、缩小或换角色都能说明选择；不把遇到困难当成适应力不足，也不要求用私人经历解释不愿继续。
paragraphs.en: For the small unfamiliar task, identify support before starting, a review point and changes to communicate. Imagine roles without accepting a real task. Review what this trial clarifies. Keeping, narrowing or changing the role can each express a choice. Difficulty establishes no lack of adaptability, and declining continuation requires no personal history.

title.zh: 借一个创作场景交换想法
title.en: Exchange ideas through a creative scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果想试一次没做过的创作分工，你会先选多小的版本，何时决定继续、调整或换角色？”各提一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不要求合作、发消息或证明像哪个人物。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For an unfamiliar creative role, how small would the first version be and when would you choose to continue, adjust or change roles?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without collaborating, sending a message or proving resemblance.

title.zh: 复盘：约定是否让责任更容易共担
title.en: Review whether an agreement makes responsibility shareable

paragraphs.zh: 沿用两种期待指向同一任务的例子，把谁决定、谁做什么和哪处尚未同意分开。想一句能把分歧带回共同讨论的话，而不是由自己替两边定案。可以只在纸上整理。复盘关注责任是否被看见、是否能提出修改和退出；如果仍全靠你撑住，值得重新分担，不用保持“最成熟的人”形象。
paragraphs.en: For two expectations about one task, separate who decides, who does each part and what remains unagreed. Draft a sentence reopening discussion rather than deciding for both people. Work on paper. Review visible responsibility and room to revise or step back. If everything still depends on you, revisit the distribution without preserving an image as the most mature person.

title.zh: 借一个创作场景交换想法
title.en: Exchange ideas through a creative scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果两个人期待你用不同方式做同一件事，你会怎样把决定权、能做的部分和重谈时点放到一起说明？”各提一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不要求合作、发消息或证明像哪个人物。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If two people wanted different approaches to one task, how would you clarify decision-making, your contribution and when to revisit the arrangement?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without collaborating, sending a message or proving resemblance.
